Implemented both requested improvements.

- Pasting a URL now automatically fetches its page title, description, and favicon.
- Title is no longer required—the domain becomes a fallback if metadata cannot be retrieved.
- Added a manual “Fetch details” retry button.
- Added an Edit action to each bookmark’s overflow menu.
- Editing supports the URL, title, description, collection, and tags.
- Metadata fetching includes redirect limits and private-network protection.

Verified with browser tests covering automatic metadata retrieval, saving, editing, tags, and mobile navigation. All tests pass.

Updated app: [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000)
